description: Configuration for alleyway rooms and exploration

entrance.title: Dark Alley Entrance
entrance.description: You stand at the entrance of a dark alleyway. Shadows dance under flickering neon signs.

dead_end.title: Dead End
dead_end.description: A brick wall covered in gang tags. The smell of garbage is overwhelming.

side_street.title: Side Street
side_street.description: A narrow street where deals go down in the open.

dumpster.title: Behind the Dumpster
dumpster.description: You hide in the shadows of a massive steel bin.

hidden_entrance.title: Hidden Entrance
hidden_entrance.description: A heavy steel door hidden behind a stack of crates.

underground.title: Underground Passage
underground.description: Damp, dark, and dangerous. Echoes of footsteps haunt the tunnel.

secret_room.title: The Pimp Vault
secret_room.description: A heavily guarded room with velvet walls and gold trim. Boss territory.

abandoned_building.title: Abandoned Building
abandoned_building.description: A decaying structure once belonging to the elite.

sewer_entrance.title: Sewer Entrance
sewer_entrance.description: A rusty manhole cover leading to the city's underbelly.

sewer_tunnels.title: Sewer Tunnels
sewer_tunnels.description: Labyrinth of toxic runoff and glowing graffiti. Home of the Reaper.

rooftop_access.title: Rooftop Access
rooftop_access.description: High above the chaos, the wind howls between skyscrapers.

penthouse_ruins.title: Penthouse Ruins
penthouse_ruins.description: Madame Velvet's shattered palace. The ultimate view of the city.

underground_market.title: Underground Market
underground_market.description: Illegal goods and blood sports are traded here freely.

hidden_lab.title: Hidden Lab
hidden_lab.description: High-tech equipment producing the city's purest product.

illegal_arena.title: The Blood Pit
illegal_arena.description: An arena where Jax hosts matches. The air smells of copper and sweat.

old_warehouse.title: Old Warehouse
old_warehouse.description: A massive storage space filled with rusted machinery.

loading_dock.title: The Loading Dock
loading_dock.description: Where the Butcher processes his shipments. Blood stains the concrete.

maintenance_shaft.title: Maintenance Shaft
maintenance_shaft.description: Cramped crawlspace filled with pipes and steam.

flooded_chamber.title: Flooded Chamber
flooded_chamber.description: Ankle-deep water hides what lurks beneath.
